extraction.saved_article: article.txt is truncated; article.html and article-complete.txt preserve the retrieved complete article.
extraction.images: One illustrative WordPress image, downloaded as article-image-0.jpg and inspected; no code screenshot.
extraction.code: No pre/code elements in the article. nethemba-extract.json preserves the linked quoted PHP and checker; patchstack-extract.json preserves command snippets.

samples.privileged-service-account.php: Reconstructs the quoted first variant: token-gated editor creation, manage_options/install_plugins grants, current-user and auth-cookie injection, admin redirect. Synthetic token/password; class constants repaired to represent the explicitly described working future variant. The observed original has global constants accessed as absent class constants and crashes before checking the token. It must not be described as successfully executing on a victim.
samples.administrator-bootstrap.php: Reconstructs the described second variant setup mode: token parameter and m=setup, administrator insertion, stored UID, programmatic session and admin redirect. Synthetic token/password. No user-concealment logic invented: the source says its attempted hiding is ineffective.
samples.existing-administrator-login.php: Reconstructs the described minimal variant: embedded token compared to URL parameter, first administrator lookup, session injection and admin redirect. Synthetic token. No account creation, code execution, or credential extraction inferred.

identity_notes.sha256: 29 malicious main/uninstall file hashes from the Nethemba IOC/sample sections plus f99a42f622e9a638f1b27dc051a48619a5a2d7f3432a4480fecf1413253629c9, the VirusTotal file explicitly linked by the article in its Rank Math discussion. No supplied malicious MD5/SHA-1. The benign checker hash c3231f50dad00967f5076ca965a0adee76aa83b70cbac339481f198fc0ff5e56 is excluded. Tokens/triggers are not file hashes.
identity_notes.purls: Generic WordPress coordinates denote plugin identities without claiming wordpress.org registry availability. Rogue plugins were delivered by signed UpdraftCentral plugin.upload_plugin requests, not by a compromised UpdraftPlus release. Display names without versions remain bare lines; no version is invented. Their names and the parsed version map are recorded below.
identity_notes.rank_math: Rank Math PRO 3.0.123 is implicated only for downloads/updates from 2026-10-15 20:02 UTC through 2026-10-16 07:12 UTC. The article does not prove its linked standalone VirusTotal file shipped in every plugin archive. Version 3.0.124 is fixed and excluded. This is vendor-distributed plugin compromise, not an asserted Composer/source-module compromise.
identity_notes.endpoints: The article names 43.250.53.42, 2a09:bac5:4e21:2e3c::49b:9 and rank1cdn.com; Nethemba additionally names 178.83.37.220, 178.83.37.243, 178.94.218.31 as backdoor-use attempts. probe.central.updraftplus.com, 0.central.updraftplus.com, teamupdraft.com and research sites are legitimate/contextual and excluded. example.com/org are account email placeholders, not malicious infrastructure.
identity_notes.cves: CVE-2026-10795 is earlier unsigned UpdraftCentral command forgery; the current campaign uses valid keys. CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 lack reconstructable exploit details here. No CVE-name or version-based detection was added.

taxonomy_changes.micro-behaviors/communications/http/requ: Replaced by php-request-hash-equals-comparison in the same leaf: a request parameter must actually be a hash_equals argument; accepts GET/POST/REQUEST, casts, either argument position and case-insensitive PHP function spelling.
taxonomy_changes.objectives/credential-access/validation/: Moved to objectives/command-and-control/backdoor/auth-bypass; requires embedded-token comparison or privileged-account bootstrap in addition to session/redirect/request-comparison context. A dynamic magic-link token alone no longer convicts.
Moved to objectives/command-and-control/backdoor/auth-bypass with its existing matching scope; mapping corrected to authentication modification/server-side backdoor.
taxonomy_changes.objectives/persistence/login/account/cre: Renamed wordpress-token-privileged-user-bootstrap; accepts direct administrator assignment or explicit privileged capability grant; also requires session injection.
taxonomy_changes.micro-behaviors/os/user/account::wordpre: Replaced source-text scan by member-call structure. Allows omitted/default true or explicit true; false capability grants and comments do not match.
taxonomy_changes.micro-behaviors/os/security/auth/session: The two WordPress session atoms now require actual call facts.

scope: The reported mechanism is PHP/WordPress. Traits are independent of chosen plugin names, domains, accounts and trigger names; Unix and Windows are both in scope. GET/POST/REQUEST carrier and API-spelling variants are controls for future variants, not claims that every carrier was observed in the campaign. No unsupported non-WordPress context is invented.
limitations: Composite rules establish bounded co-occurrence, not control-flow or runtime execution. The code is analyzed only; no WordPress environment is executed.

verification.hostile_samples: Each must retain at least two hostile traits.
verification.controls: Controls are kept in testdata/taxonomy/updraftcentral-key-abuse/controls and mirrored under /usr/local/var/cyclotron/cleave/tests/fixtures/threat-feed-4001; no benign control is under article testdata.

Eight controls fire no suspicious or hostile traits; explicit true capability grants match, false grants and comments do not.
